samples.question: The picture shows a pale panel crossed by several dark wires. Every wire has the same dark colour and the same thickness, and each wire ends at one of the four coloured squares (red, green, blue, orange) on the rim of the panel; those squares are the ports. Exactly one wire carries a filled dark dot, clearly fatter than any wire, at its other end. Follow the wire that carries that dot, along its whole length, and report the colour of the port it ends at. Wires never cross one another. Answer unclear if the dotted wire reaches no port or more than one port, and also answer unclear if anywhere along its length the dotted wire touches, or leaves a gap narrower than two wire widths to, any other wire or any port other than the one at its own end. Which port does the dotted wire reach: red, green, blue, orange, or unclear?
